title: Stream-R1: Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation for Streaming Video Generation
task: Streaming video generation acceleration via reliability-aware distillation
key_results: Consistent improvements across visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment on streaming video benchmarks without architectural modification
comments: The two-level reweighting scheme (inter-rollout and intra-spatiotemporal) is a principled approach, though practical computational overhead of reward model inference during training warrants clarification.
